conflict_areas.description: plumbing firms anywhere in Québec administrative region 02 (Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean), including the city of Saguenay, its boroughs and the merged former towns. Martin Lepage, 27 Oct 2026, 3:55 PM ET: unless in Saguenay, nothing conflicts with SOS. 4:30 PM ET, first-hand to Argus: Saguenay means the whole region, not only the city. 30 Oct 2026, 12:39 PM ET: 'Seulement la plomberie au Saguenay est un conflit, pas l'excavation.' Excavation, paving, asphalt and terrassement firms are not this conflict anywhere.
conflict_areas.province_municipality_source: MAMH Répertoire des municipalités, https://donneesouvertes.affmunqc.net/repertoire/MUN.csv, column munnom only, 1281 organisations, checked 2026-10-27. An exact match that is not a region-02 municipality is outside and is decided before partial-name containment. La Baie-James is not a repertoire row; the row is Eeyou Istchee Baie-James (Nord-du-Québec). A comma-separated locality is outside only when that part is an exact MAMH municipality outside region 02 and not a shared region-02 name; every other comma address falls through to containment on the whole address. Domaine-du-Roy, Maria-Chapdelaine and Lac-Saint-Jean-Est are MRC names, not municipalities, and are unknown. A G7 or G8 postal code anywhere in the address is unknown and held.
conflict_areas.rbq_subcategory_source: RBQ official sub-category list (Règlement sur la qualification professionnelle des entrepreneurs et des constructeurs-propriétaires, annexes II and III): https://www.rbq.gouv.qc.ca/licence/determiner-vos-sous-categories-de-licence/entrepreneur-specialise/sous-categories-dentrepreneur-specialise/ (checked 2026-10-23 06:50 EDT). 15.5 = Entrepreneur en plomberie (annexe II). 2.5 (Entrepreneur en excavation et terrassement, annexe III) was removed: Martin Lepage, 30 Oct 2026, 12:39 PM ET: 'Seulement la plomberie au Saguenay est un conflit, pas l'excavation.' Excavation, paving, asphalt and terrassement firms are not this conflict anywhere. Matched exactly against the 'Sous-catégories' codes nested in the licence's 'Catégories et sous-catégories' list (JSON file). Not listed, for Martin to decide: 2.4 systèmes d'assainissement autonome, 2.6 pieux et fondations spéciales, 2.7 travaux d'emplacement, 15.4 chauffage hydronique.
conflict_areas.rbq_required_note: The Lavoie conflict (sos-plomberie-excavation-lavoie; the id is kept for audit continuity) is not a province-wide licence check. Martin Lepage, 27 Oct 2026, 3:55 PM ET: unless in Saguenay, nothing conflicts with SOS. 4:30 PM ET, first-hand to Argus: (1) 'Saguenay' means the whole Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean administrative region (Québec region 02), including Alma and Roberval, not only the city. (2) The Lavoie conflict applies anywhere in that region; when another hold also applies, the record lists each reason separately. (3) 'Yes, keep a separate RBQ licence-check hold for construction firms everywhere.' 30 Oct 2026, 12:39 PM ET: 'Seulement la plomberie au Saguenay est un conflit, pas l'excavation.' Excavation, paving, asphalt and terrassement firms are not this conflict anywhere. Inside the region, plumbing selectors, plumbing keywords, or RBQ 15.5 hold this conflict. A genuine RBQ no-match still holds this conflict when the firm looks like plumbing. A generic, excavation, paving or terrassement construction_trades firm does not; it gets only the separate rbq-licence-unverified hold. Outside the region, this conflict does not hold. An unreadable town stays fail-closed for this conflict when the trade signals or the codes match. A town string that contains a listed municipality but does not normalise to one is unknown and held. Municipalities checked 2026-10-27 from the MAMH Répertoire des municipalités, https://donneesouvertes.affmunqc.net/repertoire/MUN.csv (region administrative Saguenay--Lac-Saint-Jean (02), 59 organisations, including Mashteuiatsh and the unorganized territories in that file), boroughs from https://donneesouvertes.affmunqc.net/repertoire/ARR.csv (Chicoutimi, Jonquière, La Baie), and former towns named in Order in Council 841-2001, Gazette officielle du Québec, https://www.publicationsduquebec.gouv.qc.ca/fileadmin/gazette/pdf_encrypte/lois_reglements/2001F/36499.pdf (Laterrière, Lac-Kénogami, Shipshaw, Canton de Tremblay; Canton-Tremblay is that same canton without the particle 'de'). Former municipalities and sectors checked 2026-10-27 and listed as inside the region: Arvida, a sector of the Jonquière borough in Saguenay (Commission de toponymie, https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=72345), whose fiche also records the 1975 fusion of the cities of Arvida, Kénogami and Jonquière; Kénogami, the former city now part of Saguenay (https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=32311); Port-Alfred, a sector of Saguenay regrouped into La Baie in 1976 (https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=72508); Grande-Baie, the municipality that fused on 1 January 1975 with Port-Alfred and Bagotville into La Baie, now a borough of Saguenay (https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=26319); Bagotville, a sector of Saguenay (https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=72350); Delisle, a sector of Alma since 21 February 2001 (https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=96950); Isle-Maligne (1924), Naudville (1944) and Riverbend (1925), annexed to Alma (https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/ToposWeb/Fiche.aspx?no_seq=1013); Dolbeau (code 92025) and Mistassini (code 92020), regrouped on 1997-12-17 into Dolbeau-Mistassini, and Métabetchouan, regrouped on 1998-12-30 with Lac-à-la-Croix into Métabetchouan–Lac-à-la-Croix (Commission de toponymie, https://toponymie.gouv.qc.ca/ct/pdf/modifications_municipalites.pdf, document updated 23 September 2026); Saint-Bruno, amalgamated with Hébertville and the village of Hébertville-Station into Municipalité d'Hébertville by Order in Council 1498-2025, in force 1 January 2026, in MRC Lac-Saint-Jean-Est (https://www.publicationsduquebec.gouv.qc.ca/fileadmin/gazette/pdf_encrypte/lois_reglements/2025A/107844.pdf). The plain name Lac-Saint-Jean is not a municipality or sector in those sources; it is in unresolved_place_names and is unknown, so it is held and never classified outside. A postal-code-only address whose FSA starts with G7 or G8 (postal_fsa_prefixes) is unknown and held, not treated as a municipality. Chicoutimi-Nord is not a listed municipality; because the name contains Chicoutimi it is unknown and held. Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville is an exact MAMH municipality outside region 02, so Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville is outside and not held. A G7 or G8 postal code anywhere in the address, not only a postal-code-only town, is unknown and held. An exact match on the full MAMH repertoire (column munnom, 1281 organisations, checked 2026-10-27) that is not a region-02 municipality is outside and is decided before partial-name containment. The repertoire name for La Baie-James is Eeyou Istchee Baie-James.

rbq_licence_hold.description: construction_trades firms anywhere whose RBQ licence is not a verified match. Martin Lepage, 27 Oct 2026, 4:30 PM ET, first-hand to Argus: 'Yes, keep a separate RBQ licence-check hold for construction firms everywhere.'
rbq_licence_hold.note: Separate from sos-plomberie-excavation-lavoie. Martin Lepage, 27 Oct 2026, 4:30 PM ET, first-hand to Argus, three rulings: (1) 'Saguenay' means the whole Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean administrative region (Québec region 02), including Alma and Roberval, not only the city. (2) The Lavoie conflict covers that whole region (narrowed to plumbing only on 30 Oct 2026, 12:39 PM ET); both holds can apply to the same firm, and the record lists each reason separately. (3) 'Yes, keep a separate RBQ licence-check hold for construction firms everywhere.' Any construction_trades firm anywhere is held when the RBQ index is missing, corrupt, errors, or returns no licence match. A verified RBQ licence match passes this hold. The reason id is rbq-licence-unverified and is not attributed to sos-plomberie-excavation-lavoie. Place list checked 2026-10-27: https://donneesouvertes.affmunqc.net/repertoire/MUN.csv and https://donneesouvertes.affmunqc.net/repertoire/ARR.csv and Order in Council 841-2001 (https://www.publicationsduquebec.gouv.qc.ca/fileadmin/gazette/pdf_encrypte/lois_reglements/2001F/36499.pdf).
